listen.description: Where the HTTP server listens: host:port, :port (every interface) or port.

public_url.description: The URL clients reach this server at, behind any proxy. Accepted but unused: nothing reads it, and config check warns when it is set.

roles.description: What this instance runs (X7.1): api (the HTTP API), worker (pollers, span assembly). Exactly one instance may run the worker.

instance_id.description: This instance's stable name in source health shards and the worker heartbeat; the host name when unset.

watch_config.description: Reload when the config file, a drop-in in seshi.d/, a redaction pack or a review prompt file changes, a second after the last change. Off by default: SIGHUP and POST /v1/admin/reload apply changes when you say so and report the result.

runtime_config.description: Where the settings that change at runtime live (docs/config.md, "Runtime config"). file: this file and its drop-ins hold everything, and a reload reaches this process only. store: the bucket also holds them (config/seshi.toml and config/packs/ for the data policy, runtime/sources/ for sources), every instance applies them within config_poll, and the admin API writes them.

config_poll.description: With runtime_config = store: how often each instance looks for a change in the bucket.

url.description: Where sessions go: s3://bucket/prefix, r2://bucket/prefix, az://container/prefix, gs://bucket/prefix, or file:///path for one machine.

session_token.description: A session token, for temporary credentials (s3://, r2://).

sas_token.description: A shared access signature for the container (az://), with or without its ?.

service_account_key.description: A Google service account key (gs://): the JSON key file's contents, usually { file = "/path/key.json" }.

credentials.description: Static bucket keys: access_key_id and secret_access_key for s3:// and r2://, account_key or sas_token for az://, service_account_key for gs://.

endpoint.description: An S3-compatible endpoint (MinIO, Backblaze, Wasabi…), which overrides the region; for az://, the blob endpoint, when not https://<account>.blob.core.windows.net (Azurite: http://127.0.0.1:10000/devstoreaccount1); for gs://, the JSON API root, when not https://storage.googleapis.com.

account_name.description: The Azure storage account (az://). Falls back to AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT.

deployment_id.description: This deployment's id, recorded in the layout marker (seshi.json, X1.4): the server will not start against a bucket marked for another. Without it the first server generates one.

org.description: The organization this deployment serves (X1.1); the server will not start against a bucket marked for another (X1.4).

store.description: The bucket: the source of truth (X6.1).

tokens.description: Static tokens (X5.12): owner = token, each one everything for that owner, for single-user and development setups. 16+ characters.

additionalProperties.description: a secret: a literal, { env = "NAME" } or { file = "/path" }

enabled.description: Accept the org key: members write as the username they state (X5.12).

issuer.description: The IdP's issuer URL; its keys come from its discovery document.

client_id.description: The CLI's client id, registered in the IdP as a public client (X5.7).

audience.description: The ID token audience to require, specific to this deployment (X1.4); the client id when unset.

owner_claim.description: The claim an owner ID is taken from (X5.8): sub, or oid on Entra, or email.

admin_group.description: Members of this IdP group are admins (X5.3).

groups_claim.description: The ID token claim that lists the person's groups, for admin_group.

oidc.description: Sign-in through an identity provider (X5.2). Absent: no IdP.

admins.description: Emails of people who are admins with an IdP (X5.3).

owner_aliases.description: Old owner ID = new owner ID, applied when reading and searching (X5.8).

session_keys.description: Keys that sign session tokens, by key id (X5.9). Old keys stay to verify until they expire. 32+ characters each; required with auth.oidc.

additionalProperties.description: a secret: a literal, { env = "NAME" } or { file = "/path" }

session_key_id.description: The key in session_keys that signs new session tokens; the only one when there is one.

default_visibility.description: Visibility of a session nothing else sets (X5.10): org or owner.

filter.description: Which sessions are worth storing (X4.10). It judges a session's first trace only.

min_chars.description: At least this many characters of text, tool arguments and tool results (the meta record aside).

require_user.description: At least one user record. false has no effect until the trace format accepts such sessions.

require_reply.description: At least one assistant or tool record. false has no effect until the trace format accepts such sessions.

limits.description: Size caps; past them a session is refused (422), or an OTLP request (413).

max_records_bytes.description: JSON bytes of one trace's records.

max_upload_bytes.description: Bytes of one upload's transcript as sent, before any gzip of the request.

max_otlp_bytes.description: Bytes of one OTLP request body as sent (gzipped or not); past it, 413.

max_otlp_inflated_bytes.description: Bytes of one gzipped OTLP request body once inflated; past it, 413.

records.description: Records of envelopes that were not stored (X6.4).

dropped_retention.description: How long records of envelopes model review dropped are kept (sources/<id>/dropped/).

failed_retention.description: How long records of envelopes that failed are kept (sources/<id>/failed/).

health_retention.description: How many days of source health counters are kept (sources/<id>/health/).

redaction.description: Regex redaction (F2). The built-in rules always run.

packs.description: Rule pack files (F2.1), in order, on top of the built-in pack: TOML packs (rules, sensitive_files, secret_commands, disable), and today's JSON rule files (patterns, sensitive_files, secret_commands), which load together as the `legacy` pack. Operator patterns run under RE2 (F2.2); every rule's test strings are checked at start-up. Restart to apply a change, then `seshi redact backfill` to apply it to stored sessions.

policies.description: Review policies, first match wins; none means no model review.

sources.description: Source ids it applies to; all when empty.

agents.description: Agents (formats) it applies to; all when empty.

repos.description: Repositories (the session's project) it applies to, as globs; all when empty. A session without a project matches only a policy with no repos.

on_failure.description: After the last retry: drop the envelope, or store it with regex redaction only (F3.4).

retries.description: Retries of a failed model call, or of an answer that does not fit (F3.4).

max_input_chars.description: Record text per model call; a longer envelope is split by turn (F3.7).

decision.description: The decision model: allow, redact or drop (F3.1).

provider.description: Who runs the model; review sends envelopes there (F3.5). anthropic by default; the redactor defaults to the decision step's.

model.description: The model name at that provider; claude-haiku-5-5 on anthropic by default, required for other providers.

prompt.description: The prompt, inline; seshi's default prompt when neither is set.

prompt_file.description: The prompt, from a file read at start and again on every config reload.

api_key.description: The provider key. Required for anthropic, and for openai-compatible without a base_url.

base_url.description: The provider's endpoint: a proxy, an OpenAI-compatible server or a local model. The provider's public API by default.

max_tokens.description: The output cap of one call; 4096 for the decision model, 16000 for the redactor.

effort.description: anthropic only: output_config.effort for the model; the model's own default when unset.

timeout.description: How long one call may take before it counts as failed; 60s by default.

redactor.description: The redactor LLM, called only for redact (F3.1).

provider.description: Who runs the model; review sends envelopes there (F3.5). anthropic by default; the redactor defaults to the decision step's.

model.description: The model name at that provider; claude-haiku-5-5 on anthropic by default, required for other providers.

prompt.description: The prompt, inline; seshi's default prompt when neither is set.

prompt_file.description: The prompt, from a file read at start and again on every config reload.

api_key.description: The provider key. Required for anthropic, and for openai-compatible without a base_url.

base_url.description: The provider's endpoint: a proxy, an OpenAI-compatible server or a local model. The provider's public API by default.

max_tokens.description: The output cap of one call; 4096 for the decision model, 16000 for the redactor.

effort.description: anthropic only: output_config.effort for the model; the model's own default when unset.

timeout.description: How long one call may take before it counts as failed; 60s by default.

categories.description: What the redactor looks for; seshi's default categories when empty.

name.description: The category's name; redacted text becomes [redacted:<name>].

description.description: What belongs in it, for the redactor.

examples.description: Examples of such text, for the redactor.

items.description: A review policy (F3.3). The first policy that matches an envelope reviews it.

required.description: Serverless mode (F11): when a policy's key cannot be found on a laptop, keep its sessions there until one is set. false stores them with regex redaction only, recorded as skipped.

sources.description: Sources the server ingests from on its own (F4–F7).

enabled.description: false keeps the source configured but idle.

visibility.description: Visibility of the sessions it writes (X5.10); default_visibility when unset.

filter.description: This source's session filter rules; the rest come from [filter].

labels.description: Labels put on every session the source stores (keys [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}, values up to 512 characters, at most 32). They win over labels the data carries.

quiet_period.description: Publish a session once it has had no new spans for this long (F4.4).

oneOf.description: An OTLP destination (F4): spans pushed to POST /otlp/v1/traces with its service token.

enabled.description: false keeps the source configured but idle.

visibility.description: Visibility of the sessions it writes (X5.10); default_visibility when unset.

filter.description: This source's session filter rules; the rest come from [filter].

labels.description: Labels put on every session the source stores (keys [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}, values up to 512 characters, at most 32). They win over labels the data carries.

api_url.description: The Export API's base URL, instead of https://api.<site> (a proxy, or a test server).

ml_app.description: The LLM Observability ml_app to read.

tags.description: Span tags to filter by, each key:value; a span must carry all of them.

overlap.description: How far before the checkpoint each run reads again, for late spans (F5.2).

lag.description: How far behind now each run stops (F5.2).

backfill.description: How far back the first run reads (F5.2).

page_size.description: Spans per Export API page (Datadog allows up to 5000, 50 MB a response).

quiet_period.description: Publish a session once no new spans have arrived for it for this long (F4.4).

enabled.description: false keeps the source configured but idle.

visibility.description: Visibility of the sessions it writes (X5.10); default_visibility when unset.

filter.description: This source's session filter rules; the rest come from [filter].

labels.description: Labels put on every session the source stores (keys [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}, values up to 512 characters, at most 32). They win over labels the data carries.

url.description: The bucket to read: s3://bucket/prefix, r2://bucket/prefix, az://container/prefix or gs://bucket/prefix.

prefix.description: A key prefix under the URL's own.

credentials.description: Read-only keys for the source bucket.

session_token.description: A session token, for temporary credentials (s3://, r2://).

sas_token.description: A shared access signature for the container (az://), with or without its ?.

service_account_key.description: A Google service account key (gs://): the JSON key file's contents, usually { file = "/path/key.json" }.

role.description: A role to assume instead of static keys (s3:// only).

external_id.description: The external id the role requires.

account_name.description: The Azure storage account (az://). Falls back to AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT.

include.description: Globs of keys to read; every key when empty.

format.description: auto (detect each object) or a format name (claude-code, atif…).

ordered_keys.description: Keys sort by time, so a run can start after the last key (F6.2).

path.description: A template for keys under the prefix, such as {username}/{session}.jsonl: {session} names the session, {format} its format, {project} and {branch} the work, {email}, {name}, {username}, {git_email} and {git_name} identity claims (never the owner, X5.4); * and ** match the rest. Keys that do not match are skipped. Without it the session is the key under the prefix.

oneOf.description: A bucket other systems write sessions to (F6), polled: S3 or S3-compatible (s3://, r2://), Azure Blob Storage (az://) or Google Cloud Storage (gs://).

enabled.description: false keeps the source configured but idle.

visibility.description: Visibility of the sessions it writes (X5.10); default_visibility when unset.

filter.description: This source's session filter rules; the rest come from [filter].

labels.description: Labels put on every session the source stores (keys [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}, values up to 512 characters, at most 32). They win over labels the data carries.

api_key.description: A Cursor API key (a member's, or a service account's): the poller reads the cloud agents it can see.

api_url.description: The Cloud Agents API's base URL, instead of https://api.cursor.com (a test server).

lookback.description: How far back Cursor still has a run's events (it keeps them 24 hours, F7): agents untouched for longer are not read on the first poll, and a run carried past the session filter is read again only within it.

max_streams.description: Run streams one poll opens at most (Cursor allows 60 a minute); the rest wait for the next.

usage.description: Also read each run's token usage (one more call per run).

oneOf.description: Cursor Cloud agents (F7), polled through the Cloud Agents API.

enabled.description: Serve search (GET /v1/search, seshi search) from a local index built from the change feed.

path.description: The index file on local disk; ":memory:" keeps it in memory. Default: seshi/search/<deployment>.sqlite in the user cache folder.

interval.description: How long the indexer waits after catching up before it reads the feed again.

events.description: Which trace events are indexed, by role: prompts, assistant text, and tool calls (names and inputs, so file paths and commands) by default (F10.1).

heartbeat_interval.description: How often the worker writes worker/heartbeat.json (X7.5).

assembly_interval.description: How often the span assembler looks for sessions whose spans have gone quiet (F4.4, X7.4).

capture.description: Capture integrations (F9), and the org's exclude and tool-call redaction lists.

allow_retract.description: Let the machine that uploaded a session retract it with its per-session secret (F9.7).

exclude.description: The org's exclude list: sessions in these repositories (owner/name on any host, host/owner/name on one) or folders (starting with /, ~, a drive or \\server, and everything under them) are never stored, from any source. The server applies it to its own sources and refuses an upload whose repo it names (repositories only); laptops download it (GET /v1/capture/rules) and apply it with their own capture.exclude. * matches within a path segment, ** across any number of them; blank entries and # comments are skipped. Drop-ins in seshi.d/ add to it.

redact_tool_calls.description: The org's list of places whose sessions are stored with every tool call's input and output replaced by [redacted:tool-call] (prompts, replies, tool names, call ids, order and failures kept). Entries are written and matched as in exclude, which wins for a place on both lists. Laptops download it (GET /v1/capture/rules) and redact before upload, with their own capture.redact_tool_calls; the server redacts the sessions of its own sources (Cursor Cloud) and any upload whose repo it names (repositories only). Drop-ins in seshi.d/ add to it.

secrets.description: Sealing keys for secrets stored in the bucket.

keys.description: Keys that seal the secrets of sources the admin API stores in the bucket (runtime_config = store), by key id. 32+ characters each. Old keys stay to unseal until `seshi admin secrets reseal` has run.

additionalProperties.description: a secret: a literal, { env = "NAME" } or { file = "/path" }

key_id.description: The key in secrets.keys that seals new secrets; the only one when there is one.

description: seshi server configuration (seshi.toml). Precedence: flags, then SESHI_* env, then this file, then defaults.
